title: Spex Machina Bead Map
description: Schema for .bead-map.json. Links spec node IDs to bead IDs with structured metadata.

next_id.description: Next auto-increment ID for new records.

records.description: Mapping records linking spec nodes to beads.

id.description: Unique record ID, auto-assigned by MappingStore.

spec_node_id.description: Identity of the spec node. For component/data_flow/test_section records this is the 12-char hex identity hash. For proposal epic records it is the proposal reference.

bead_id.description: Bead ID from the issue tracker.

bead_type.description: Bead issue type (e.g. epic, feature, task).

node_type.description: Spec node type. Optional; present on records that distinguish proposal epics from component/data_flow/test_section records.

module.description: Module name containing the spec node. Empty for proposal epic records.

component.description: Component or section name within the module; for proposal epics this is the proposal reference.

content_file.description: Relative path to the spec content markdown file. Empty for proposal epic records.

spec_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the spec content at time of mapping. Empty for proposal epic records.

bead_status.description: Bead status populated at runtime by preflight/apply operations.
